name: Taj Falaknuma Palace
about: Built in 1893 on a hill above the old city, Falaknuma was the work of Nawab Vikar-ul-Umra and later a palace of the Nizams of Hyderabad. Its name is usually translated as “mirror of the sky”.
After a long restoration it opened as a Taj hotel in 2010, and it remains one of the most complete pictures of how Hyderabad’s nobility lived and received its guests.
alt: The viewing balcony at Taj Falaknuma

name: Café Niloufer
about: Café Niloufer began in 1978 with the idea of a chai that tasted of Hyderabad, and grew from one outlet at Lakdikapul into a city institution.
Irani chai and Osmania biscuits at Niloufer are, for many visitors and most residents, what a Hyderabad morning is meant to taste like.
alt: Bun maska and Irani chai at Niloufer

name: Goyaz
about: Goyaz is a Hyderabad-born jewellery brand known for handcrafted, gold-plated silver pieces, made with bridal and occasion wear in mind.
Its work brings a contemporary eye to a city whose relationship with jewellery goes back centuries.
draft: Written from public sources; the photo is general, not of this brand

name: Ramoji Film City
about: Opened in 1996 on the edge of Hyderabad, Ramoji Film City is listed by Guinness World Records as the largest film studio complex in the world.
Its streets, gardens and sets have stood in for places all over the world, and it remains a working part of Indian cinema.
alt: Themed gardens at Ramoji Film City

name: Paradise
about: Paradise began in 1953 as a small canteen inside a cinema in Secunderabad. Its biryani went on to become one of the most recognised tastes of the city.
For many first-time visitors, this is the name that comes up before they have even landed.

name: HICC
about: The Hyderabad International Convention Centre is one of the city’s main venues for international conferences and events, in the HITEC City business district.
If you are here for a conference, there is a good chance you will spend time here. We plan the rest of the city around it.

name: Heartfulness
about: Kanha Shanti Vanam, outside Hyderabad, is the global headquarters of the Heartfulness Institute. Its meditation centre, inaugurated in 2020, is among the largest in the world.
Heartfulness offers its practices of meditation free of charge, and the campus is known for its calm and its green nurseries.
alt: Under the great canopy at Kanha

name: Karachi Bakery
about: Karachi Bakery opened in 1953 at Moazzam Jahi Market, started by a family who came to Hyderabad after Partition.
Its fruit biscuits have become one of the most carried-home tastes of the city, packed into suitcases at the airport every day.

name: Shilparamam
about: Set up in 1992 at Madhapur, Shilparamam is a crafts village where artisans from across India work, sell and keep their traditions in view.
Its rural museum and stalls make it one of the easiest places in the city to meet makers face to face.
